metadata.description: Public AI agent skills — practical skills spanning multiple domains, from engineering, idea validation all the way to knowledge management.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Agent harness: harness:pull (alias swarm, peer-to-peer) and harness:assign (alias direct, thin dispatcher) over a shared work board with claim/lease/reap mechanics, charter, escalation ladder and role cards; tracker (live dependency map of a build's progress); policy (layered .agents/policy settings and their loader); session-hygiene (handoffs and session nudges); guard hooks for polling wakes, unlinked messages, repeated review spawns, secret reads, large whole-file reads and empty questions; session hooks that nudge a handoff or a session name, state a duration before a slow command, remind after compaction and lint the hooks and memory index; a statusline script.

plugins.name: model
plugins.description: Work with the model itself: extension-author (skills, plugins and hooks across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, oh-my-pi), reflect (mine sessions for agent struggles and propose fixes) and tiers (route each subagent to the cheapest model tier: one tier-to-model map, the reader, builder and reasoner agents, and the model-tier-guard hook that makes every spawn name its tier).

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Plain, human prose: unslop (remove AI tells) and prose-craft (compose and tighten).

plugins.name: voice
plugins.description: The always-on plain-voice output style and the command that sets its depth and length for a session.

plugins.name: presentation
plugins.description: Plan, prepare, and improve presentations with 88 patterns and antipatterns, built on the teachings of Neal Ford, Presentation Patterns (Ford, McCullough, Schutta, 2012). Includes both the pattern catalog and the prep workflow; install together, they share reference files.

plugins.name: publishing
plugins.description: Author, validate, and cross-publish blog posts to Astro, dev.to, Medium, and Substack.

plugins.name: education
plugins.description: Learning and self-assessment: find-ai-moat (interview one question at a time to find where your work complements AI versus where a model already does it, then give three concrete 30-day moves to widen the gap in your favor).

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Design and plan before building: architect (work package), ramble (grill a rough idea into a brief), decompose (cut into parallel units), graph-engine (waves and critical path), project-docs (standard docs/ with a validator).

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Operate and secure what ships: ci (harden GitHub Actions workflows and configure Renovate: template-injection prevention, SHA-pinned actions, scoped permissions, zizmor, dependency-bot rules), security (gitleaks, trufflehog, osv-scanner, semgrep, SkillSpector, garak, nuclei, strix plus an AI triage pass) and deploy (deploy a released or integrated revision and verify it from real logs or state; a failed verification leaves the stage open with the evidence).

plugins.name: swe-workflows
plugins.description: The engineered per-task software workflow: the implement skill (spec-check, test-first ATDD→TDD, quality, isolated adversarial review, change-request, review loop, integrate, retrospective) plus a policy-gate hook that enforces the repo's .agents/policy at commit/ready/integrate (blocks in mode:team, warns in mode:single), and the default `sw-development` procedure (procedures/sw-development.md). Siblings triage and find-bug feed implement; by-angle (red-first block loop plus four review angles) and code-quality (risk from complexity, coverage, duplication metrics, and a comment-quality pass) are the read-only review skills. document writes and updates one docs page per component under docs/components/. Also ships the skill-gate hook, the isolated-reviewer agent and the feature, fix, infra, investigate, next, pickup, review and worker commands. Needs the `harness` plugin (`harness:policy`) for the policy loader and the `design` plugin (`design:project-docs`) for document's docs tooling.

plugins.name: swe
plugins.description: Engineering practice skills: rust and typescript (house guidelines on every change) and performance (profile, optimize, benchmark).

plugins.name: code-graph
plugins.description: Keep the codebase-memory-mcp code graph fresh and in use: index the repo at session start and after edits, rewrite worktree indexing to the main checkout, and nudge agents and subagents to query the graph before grep or find sweeps.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git and GitHub pull-request workflow in an opinionated house style: worktrees, conventional/atomic commits, branch naming, draft-PR conventions, the review-thread reply/resolve procedure, multi-repo stacks, and the force-push gotchas. Ships the git-guard, worktree-path-guard and pr-poll-reminder hooks and the pr-watcher agent.

plugins.name: nix
plugins.description: Operate correctly inside Nix + direnv development repos — dev-shell entry, nix fmt over cargo fmt, the result-symlink and crane-rustflags build traps, and a lightweight pre-commit override.

plugins.name: yubikey
plugins.description: Developer security setup: hardware-backed keys with YubiKey (offline OpenPGP root key, on-card daily subkeys, FIDO2 SSH keys, signed commits, GitHub 2FA), plus the loss and recovery runbook.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Personal knowledge: llm-wiki (create, maintain and query a linked Markdown wiki designed for LLM navigation) and media-digest (fetch the transcript of any yt-dlp media or the text of a web article, save it locally, and write a loss-checked summary with a short version and follow-up points).

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research and test ideas: forge-idea (forge a rough idea into a viable one through cooperative, research-driven iteration) and grounded-research (answer a question under a fixed evidence contract: primary sources first, every claim cited with URL and date, fact kept apart from hearsay).
